summary: Brinks filed an 8-K disclosing two shareholder lawsuits challenging its pending acquisition of NCR Atleos. Under the February 26, 2026 Merger Agreement, a Brink's subsidiary will merge with NCR Atleos, which will then be merged into another subsidiary. The all-stock deal is subject to shareholder votes at special meetings on June 30, 2026. The complaints, filed in New York Supreme Court, allege negligent misrepresentation in the NCR Atleos proxy statement. Brink's took no position on the lawsuits. The combination would create a cash-management powerhouse. Watch for potential settlement or court ruling that could delay close, affecting risk-arb spread.
